title: Triage classification is reproducible on identical inputs
statement: classifyFailure(reading) MUST return a TriageVerdict whose id is sha256(subject_evidence_ref|classification) sliced to 16 hex chars, whose classification is one of {plant_bug, sensor_error, policy_issue, reference_gap, inconclusive}, and whose confidence is an object with a score in [0,1]. The same reading classified twice MUST produce identical id and classification (modulo generated_at).
rationale: Article 15 makes triage the routing decision for every failure. A non-reproducible classifier means the same fault routes to different disciplines on different runs, breaking the audit chain. The rule-based MVP is deterministic by construction. Phase-9 Batch 9.F ships the Article-23 cross-family ladder: when two classifications from one family disagree, a breaker from a different family votes; persistent disagreement (breaker inconclusive) escalates to a human per Article 19. The breaker call emits confidence.method='article-23-cross-family-breaker' for audit traceability.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
